text:
Lithium has 3 protons. With 3 neutrons, the nucleus is \({}^6\mathrm{Li}\).

Using the constituent-mass approximation,
\[
m_Xc^2 \approx 3m_pc^2+3m_nc^2
=3(0.939)+3(0.940)=5.637\ \text{GeV}.
\]

For \(v=0.96c\),
\[
\gamma=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-0.96^2}}
=\frac{1}{0.28}
=\frac{25}{7}.
\]

Thus the total relativistic energy is
\[
E=\gamma m_Xc^2
=\frac{25}{7}(5.637)
=20.1321\ \text{GeV}.
\]

This matches option (A).

Answer: A
